scope: Safe projection of owner-authorized SWE5001 runtime and generator retirement on 12 November 2026; private operator receipts retained outside Git

runtime.method: Existing authenticated SSO operator assignment; privately reviewed runtime-only saved Terraform destroy plans, applied in two stages
runtime.normalScriptBoundary: env-down.sh has no archival step; it destroys runtime, retries once after 60 seconds, then invokes env-status.sh. The experimental ALB-log bucket had force_destroy=false, so Terraform would not automatically empty a nonempty bucket.

archive.destination: Existing private generator-evidence S3 bucket; new unique archive prefix, no existing objects overwritten
archive.snapshotEvidenceBoundary: Preserves the stopped disk, including any uncollected files; no snapshot restore or filesystem-content acceptance test was performed.

runtimeAbsenceScopes: Tagged VPC, subnets, ENIs, volumes, security groups, routes, addresses and launch templates
NAT instances and Auto Scaling group
Exact runtime IAM roles and instance profile
SNS topics and four SQS queues
Runtime log groups, alarms and dashboard
generatorAbsenceScopes: Exact instance terminated and original root disk absent
Temporary IAM role, instance profile and boundary absent
retentionReadbacks: Log archive objects and manifest present
Permanent CloudFront distribution deployed and SPA bucket present
Shared generator VPC and subnet present
independentVerification.limitations: Point-in-time checks of known identities and scoped service inventories, not an account-wide cost audit, whole-stack drift check, snapshot restore test or SWE5006 health test.

retainedStorage: Private generator-evidence S3 bucket with original results and log archives
One completed encrypted generator disk snapshot
